### Source

Choose the framework entry that matches your application.

::: code-group

```html [Web Component]
<script type="module">
  import '@zeus-web/alert/wc/auto'
</script>

<zw-alert variant="success">
  <zw-alert-title>Deployment complete</zw-alert-title>
  <zw-alert-description>
    The new version is now available.
  </zw-alert-description>
</zw-alert>
```

```tsx [React]
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@zeus-web/alert/react'

export function AlertExample() {
  return (
    <Alert variant="success">
      <AlertTitle>Deployment complete</AlertTitle>
      <AlertDescription>The new version is now available.</AlertDescription>
    </Alert>
  )
}
```

```vue [Vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@zeus-web/alert/vue'
</script>

<template>
  <Alert variant="success">
    <AlertTitle>Deployment complete</AlertTitle>
    <AlertDescription>The new version is now available.</AlertDescription>
  </Alert>
</template>
```

:::

## Add

```bash
zweb add alert
```

## Imports

Styled registry component:

```tsx
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert'
```

Primitive React wrapper:

```tsx
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@zeus-web/alert/react'
```

Web Component entry:

```ts
import '@zeus-web/alert/wc/auto'
```

## Props

| Prop      | Type                                                                          | Default   | Description            |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ---------------------- |
| `variant` | `AlertVariant`<br />Values: `default`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` | `default` | Visual style variant.  |
| `live`    | `string`                                                                      | `polite`  | ARIA live region mode. |

## Events

No public events documented.

## Slots

| Slot      | Description    |
| --------- | -------------- |
| `default` | Alert content. |

## AI usage rules

Do:

- Use Alert for system messages.
- Use AlertTitle for the heading.
- Use AlertDescription for the detail.

Do not:

- Do not use Alert for persistent banners outside the page content.

## Examples

### React styled usage

```tsx
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Alert variant="info">
      <AlertTitle>Heads up!</AlertTitle>
      <AlertDescription>Info message here.</AlertDescription>
    </Alert>
  )
}
```
